about_the_game:
"Make 10 is mightier than the sword!"

IZEA is a fresh new strategic battle game that fuses “Make 10” × Puzzle Calculation × RPG × Roguelite × Deckbuilding.

Use numbers and arithmetic operators to hit the enemy’s designated Weak Number and deal damage strategically.
Your calculation skills and creativity are the keys to victory!

The enemy’s weakness is numbers!
Attack with math in this brand-new turn-based battle system!

Simple commands, deep strategy

Your only commands are numbers (1–9) and operators (+, −, ×, ÷).
The closer your equation’s result is to the enemy’s Weak Number, the more damage you’ll deal.

Match the number exactly, and unleash a powerful strike that hits all enemies while also nullifying their skills!
Which enemy’s skill will you counter? Can you line up the perfect result?
Your math skills will be put to the test!

Build your favorite strategy!

Form a party from 7 cute and quirky allies

Throughout the story you’ll meet 7 unique characters, each with their own traits and skill cards—over 50 kinds in total.
From classic roles like attacker and healer, to special IZEA-only abilities such as “change a number,” every character brings something different.
It’s up to you who to team up with!

Customize your numbers!

Power up skill cards at the Skill Shop

Having trouble winning? Power up your numbers!
As you progress, you’ll unlock the ability to add special effects to number cards.
Which effect attaches depends on the character, making every setup unique.
Find your favorite number and make it yours!

A pop, fun, and dystopian story across 7 chapters!

Embark on the main scenario “To the 4tress of 10ebera”, where you and your allies take on the evil Demon Lord Tenebrer.
Uncover the pasts, flaws, and hidden sides of the cute-but-complex characters as you face various incidents and stories.

In addition to multiple endings from the main story, every ally also has special scenarios and endings unlocked through building bonds with them.

Face endless entertainment!

The roguelite “To the 10pest” mode

IZEA also features an endless roguelite mode.
Bring your strongest party and skill set, and use the upgrade items you earn in battle to survive against enemies that grow stronger without end.

Track your progress with rankings for defeated enemies, highest damage dealt, and damage taken.
Pull off an amazing combo or massive damage? Show it off to the world!
